from __future__ import annotations

from tilefoundry import func
from tilefoundry.dsl import Tensor
from tilefoundry.dsl.tf import *  # noqa: F401, F403

@func
def add_norm(
    x: Tensor[(2, 5120), "bf16"],
    residual: Tensor[(2, 5120), "bf16"],
    weight: Tensor[(5120,), "f32"]
):
    v0 = cast(x, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r20480/w40960@total,r20480/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    v1 = cast(residual, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r20480/w40960@total,r20480/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    v2 = add(v0, v1)  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r81920/w40960@total,r81920/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=17 bound-by=memory
    v3 = cast(v2, dtype="bf16")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "bf16"]; compute-cost flops=bf16:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40960/w20480@total,r40960/w20480@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    v4 = cast(v3, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r20480/w40960@total,r20480/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    v5 = unary(v4, kind="square")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40960/w40960@total,r40960/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=11 bound-by=memory
    v6 = reduce(v5, axes=(-1,), keepdim=True, kind="mean")  # Tensor[(2, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40960/w8@total,r40960/w8@cta; roofline ideal-ns=6 bound-by=memory
    v0_2 = 1e-06  # Tensor[(), "f32", "umat"]
    v7 = add(v6, v0_2)  # Tensor[(2, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:2@logical,2@total,2@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r8/w8@total,r8/w8@cta;rmem:r4/w0@total,r4/w0@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v8 = unary(v7, kind="rsqrt")  # Tensor[(2, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost other-ops=special:2@logical,2@total,2@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r8/w8@total,r8/w8@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=memory
    v9 = mul(v4, v8)  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40968/w40960@total,r40968/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=11 bound-by=memory
    v10 = mul(v9, weight)  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r61440/w40960@total,r61440/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=14 bound-by=memory
    v11 = cast(v10, dtype="bf16")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "bf16"]; compute-cost flops=bf16:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40960/w20480@total,r40960/w20480@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    return (v3, v11)

gate_up.scope: Equal automatic seven-stage mainloops; only scheduler swizzle8 to16 changes.
gate_up.protocol: Three rounds, twenty alternating pairs per round, ten graph repetitions per sample.
gate_up.numerical_check: Equal at zero absolute and relative tolerances. The raw bitwise_equal flag was not an integer-bit comparison.

combined_candidate.scope: Changes automatic7 to explicit5 and swizzle8 to16 together. Time saved cannot be attributed to either change alone.

affected_operator_collection.scope: 48 filtered cases with current small-row dispatch and auto7 swizzle16. Dirty-source diagnostic, not full301 acceptance.
affected_operator_collection.protocol: Complete static maximum-shape operations; three independent warm rounds, twenty alternating-order pairs/round,100 graph repetitions/sample. External timing events inside each graph exclude host submission gaps. No profiler during timing. Fixtures use immutable sources and repeatable destinations. DSpark append shares one cache after independent-cache verification. Stateless Q/K timing uses matching output-address sequences in one graph pool after independent verification; whole functions keep their output allocations. Other mutable destinations remain isolated. Before timing, compare both backends' returns and written cache/state slots at existing tolerances.
